Name: Riken S.
Subject: Interest in contributing to Cisco's Core ASIC & RTL Team
Body:
Hi Riken,

I’ve been following Cisco’s persistent push into high-performance silicon, and I know that the Core ASIC team is tackling some of the industry’s toughest latency and coherence challenges. I’m looking for an environment where rigorous verification is just as valued as the architecture itself.

My technical work has been focused on exactly that memory hierarchy. I recently architected a fully configurable L1/L2 cache controller in Verilog, implementing complex coherence protocols (Write-Back/Write-Allocate) and low-latency LRU replacement policies. I verified the design using Synopsys VCS, debugging cycle-accurate waveforms to ensure the kind of functional correctness Cisco demands.

I am actively pursuing an ASIC or RTL design internship for Summer 2026. I value the perspective of engineers who are already solving these problems at scale, and I would welcome any direction on how my background might align with the opportunities on your team.

If your group is taking interns, I would strongly appreciate the chance to interview. I am confident I can ramp up quickly on your tools and contribute to your verification or design execution immediately. I have attached my resume and would appreciate a short conversation to discuss how I can help your team this summer.
